def show_history(self):
        import tkinter as tk
        from tkinter import ttk, filedialog
        from collections import Counter

        dialog = tk.Toplevel(self.root)
        dialog.title('History — UTC storage / local display')
        dialog.geometry('1100x650')
        bar = ttk.Frame(dialog)
        bar.pack(fill='x')
        counts = Counter(a['name'] for a in self.by_id.values())
        choices = {'All applications': None}
        for code, item in sorted(self.by_id.items(), key=lambda pair: (pair[1]['name'].casefold(), pair[0])):
            name = item['name']
            if counts[name] > 1 or name == 'All applications':
                name = f'{name} ({code})'
            while name in choices:
                name += f' ({code})'
            choices[name] = code
        selected = self.selected()
        initial = next((name for name, code in choices.items() if code == selected), 'All applications')
        app = tk.StringVar(value=initial)
        status = tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Combobox(bar, textvariable=app, values=list(choices), width=38, state='readonly').pack(side='left')
        ttk.Combobox(bar, textvariable=status, values=['', 'PASS', 'WARN', 'FAIL', 'CANCELLED', 'DISABLED', 'RESTRICTED', 'MANUAL'], width=15, state='readonly').pack(side='left')
        tree = ttk.Treeview(dialog, columns=('time', 'app', 'status', 'duration', 'code', 'summary'), show='headings')
        tree.pack(fill='both', expand=True)
        for key in tree['columns']:
            tree.heading(key, text=key.title())
        visible_rows = []

        def refresh():
            code = choices[app.get()]
            visible_rows[:] = self.history.rows(code, status.get() or None)
            tree.delete(*tree.get_children())
            for row in visible_rows:
                tree.insert('', 'end', values=(local_time(row['timestamp']), row['display_name'], row['status'], row['duration_ms'], row['diagnostic_code'], row['safe_summary']))
            label.configure(text='')
            if code:
                state = self.history.state(code)
                label.configure(text='Last success: ' + local_time(state['last_successful']) + ' | Failure streak: ' + str(state['failure_streak']))

        def export():
            path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(parent=dialog, defaultextension='.csv')
            if path:
                try:
                    self.history.export(path, rows=visible_rows)
                except OSError:
                    self.status.set('DB-001: history export unavailable')

        ttk.Button(bar, text='Filter', command=refresh).pack(side='left')
        ttk.Button(bar, text='Export CSV', command=export).pack(side='left')
        label = ttk.Label(dialog)
        label.pack()
        refresh()
